description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6.5 tests of ../../../../problems/levelset_weno5_eno1_2d_bump_mms.esm (model LevelSetWENO5ENO1BumpMMS, test bump_hybrid) at the problem's default resolution through each binding's official simulation pathway. Hybrid WENO5/ENO1 norm (WENO5 on the whole interior, ENO1 on the three-cell wall band) on a manufactured paraboloid-plus-bump whose zero level set is a circle, at the problem's default NX = NY = 32; both upwind sides of the reconstruction are exercised by the constant wind (1, 1). The assertions live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners. The order-of-accuracy claim is gated by the matching convergence case.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
